title: API Surface: /api/presets and /api/personas don't exist; settings profiles live at /api/chat-presets
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:270 "`/api/personas` — (within characters routes)"; :272 "`/api/presets` (`/api/prompts`) — CRUD, sections, choice blocks"
reality: packages/server/src/routes/index.ts:94-162 registers no /api/presets or /api/personas prefix. Prompt presets are /api/prompts (index.ts:101; docs/development/frontend.md:465). Personas are served under the characters prefix as /api/characters/personas/* (characters.routes.ts:2465 "/personas/list", :2484 "/personas/:id", :2490 "/personas/:id/versions"). Settings profiles are /api/chat-presets (index.ts:98). chat-presets.routes.ts:2 says "Chat settings profiles (legacy route/storage names use 'chat preset')", and chat-preset.schema.ts:2 says the same for schema names.
fix: API Surface: replace the two lines with "`/api/prompts` — prompt presets: CRUD, sections, groups, choice blocks, export" and "`/api/characters/personas/*` — personas (list, get, versions/restore)". Add "`/api/chat-presets` — **settings profiles** (route, storage and schema names keep the old 'chat preset' wording)". Add one line to the Vocabulary-change callout: in code, settings profiles are still called chat presets (`chat-presets.routes.ts`, `chatPresetSettingsSchema`), so a contributor shouldn't confuse them with prompt presets (`/api/prompts`).

title: /illustrate isn't available in Conversation, and Game accepts only the bare command
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:317 "`/illustrate [range=N|range=N-M] [prompt]` (alias `/ill`) works in Conversation, Roleplay, and Game"
reality: packages/client/src/lib/slash-commands.ts:1243-1248: illustrate has `modes: ["roleplay"]` and `requiredCapabilityId: "illustrator"`. isSlashCommandAvailable (:108-114) and matchSlashCommand (:1508-1522) drop it when the mode is not listed, and ConversationInput.tsx:1037-1040 passes `mode: "conversation"`, so in Conversation `/illustrate` is sent as plain text (Conversation has `/selfie`, :1305-1309 `modes: ["conversation"]`). Game uses its own input: GameInput.tsx:127-128 `isIllustrateSlashCommand` matches only `^/(?:illustrate|ill)\s*$`, so Game takes the bare command with no prompt or `range=`. docs/chats/slash-commands.md:21 says the same: slash commands work in Conversation and Roleplay, and in Game only `/illustrate` works.
fix: Rewrite the clause: "`/illustrate [range=N|range=N-M] [prompt]` (alias `/ill`) — **Roleplay** gets the full syntax. **Game** accepts only bare `/illustrate`, the one slash command Game mode recognizes. **Conversation** has no `/illustrate`; use `/selfie` there. Both commands are hidden until the Illustrator package is installed." Keep the existing v2.4.6/v2.5.0 tags.

title: Advanced Memory Recall doesn't use the default Decision model; it needs its own Memory Decision connection
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:75 "Pick it under Connections → Connection defaults → Decision model … It drives custom-agent activation questions, … lorebook Decision fields, and opt-in Smart response order and Advanced Memory Recall."
reality: The Advanced Memory decision backend uses only the chat's own setting: packages/server/src/services/advanced-memory.ts:934-946 returns null unless `decisionEnabled && decisionConnectionId`, sets `getLocalDefault: async () => null`, and resolves `getDefaultConnection` to that per-chat connection. Schema: shared/src/types/advanced-memory.ts:11-12. Labels: en.json:186 "Memory Decision connection", :188 "Use Decision model", :189 "Create a Decision connection in Connections, then pick it here. Saved for this chat only … If it fails or takes over 10 seconds, recall uses normal search instead." A local Primary/Utility slot picked as the default Decision model is never used for memory. The skill already says this correctly elsewhere: conditional-prompts.md:183 "a per-chat Memory Decision connection, separate from the global default" and agents.md:372.
fix: Decision model paragraph: drop Advanced Memory Recall from the list driven by the default pick. Add: "Advanced Memory Recall uses a separate per-chat **Use Decision model** switch plus a **Memory Decision connection**, which must be a Decision connection (local slots aren't offered). The global default is ignored there. Misses or answers slower than 10 s fall back to ordinary recall."

title: Roleplay Commands: master switch, card label, Reminders privacy rule, Sound Cues requirement
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:176 "opt-in in-message commands, each with its own switch under Chat Settings → Agents → Roleplay Commands (all start off; no package needed unless noted) … Sound Cues … Notes and Whisper need a solo chat or Individual group generation."
reality: packages/client/src/components/chat/RoleplayCommandsSettings.tsx:34-55: the Agents section holds a card titled **Commands** (en.json:2572 roleplay.commands.title) with a master **Commands** switch. en.json:2535 says "Enable hidden commands for this roleplay. Each command starts off." The per-command switches render only when that switch is on (`{enabled && …}`). The private-context gate, `key === "notes" || key === "memory" || key === "whisper" ? privateAvailable` at :68-69, covers **Reminders** (key `memory`) as well as Notes and Whisper. Sound Cues: en.json:2571 "Requires an ElevenLabs audio connection with sound effect generation enabled." It also has its own **Sound effects connection** picker (:2566-2567).
fix: Rewrite the lead: "Under **Chat Settings → Agents → Commands**, turn on the master **Commands** switch, then each command's own switch (all start off) …". Add to the Sound Cues item: "needs an ElevenLabs Audio connection with **Game sound effects** on". Change the closing rule to "Personal Notes, Reminders and Whisper need a solo chat or Individual group mode."

title: Conversation Commands section undocumented; Schedule Updates, Cross-Post and connected-chat Notes missing; memory syntax incomplete; selfies need Illustrator
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:148 "Selfies — characters can emit `[selfie]`"; :149 "`[memory: target=\"...\"]`"; :313 "Connected chats — … `<influence>` (conversation → RP) and `<ooc>` (RP → conversation) tags". Absent: [schedule_update], [cross_post], <note>, and the Commands section.
reality: packages/shared/src/types/chat.ts:45-63 CONVERSATION_COMMAND_KEYS has 17 per-chat toggles. ChatSettingsDrawer.tsx:560-650 shows them in Chat Settings → **Commands** (en.json:5153) as Schedule Updates ("change their current status and activity"), Cross-Post ("redirect a message into another shared chat"), Selfies, Memories, Scenes, Music, Haptics, Influence, **Notes** ("save durable notes for a connected chat"), Calls and Reactions, plus the six games. chat.ts:70-81 makes selfie depend on the `illustrator` package. Regexes in services/conversation/character-commands.ts: :445 `[schedule_update: …]`, :446 `[cross_post: target="…"]`, :448 MEMORY_RE requires `[memory: target="…", summary="…"]` (a target-only tag does not match), :514/:516 `<note>…</note>` / `[note: …]`. docs/chats/connected-chats.md:59-71: `<note>` saves a durable fact that stays in the story chat's prompt every turn until cleared from Chat Settings → **Conversation Notes**.
fix: Conversation Mode: add one line: "Each command is a per-chat switch under Chat Settings → **Commands**: Schedule Updates `[schedule_update: …]`, Cross-Post `[cross_post: target=\"…\"]`, Selfies (needs the Illustrator package), Memories, Scenes, Music, Haptics, Influence, Notes, Calls, Reactions, plus the installed games." Fix the memory syntax to `[memory: target=\"…\", summary=\"…\"]`. Connected chats: add `<note>`, a durable Conversation → story fact kept in every turn until cleared under **Conversation Notes**, as opposed to the one-shot `<influence>`.

title: Embeddings aren't local-only: lorebooks and memory recall can use an embedding connection
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:358 "No native external vector DB integration (lorebook uses local embeddings only)."; :310 "messages are chunked (5 at a time), embedded with `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` running locally"
reality: packages/server/src/routes/lorebooks.routes.ts:1463-1505 vectorizes with either the local sidecar model or a connection's embedding model through `provider.embed(batchTexts, embeddingModel)`, with a remote embedding space id. Connections carry `embeddingModel`, `embeddingBaseUrl` and `embeddingConnectionId` (connection.schema.ts:87-89). Memory recall: services/memory-recall-embedding.ts resolves an embedding connection, and en.json:5448 says "Uses the local embedding model if you have one, or your embedding connection." The skill's own lorebooks.md:279 already tells users to pick a connection with an embedding model in **Semantic Search (Embeddings)**. Still true: there is no external vector-DB integration (CHUNK_SIZE 5 and DEFAULT_TOP_K 8 in memory-recall.ts:18/35 are correct).
fix: What's NOT Built-In: change to "No external vector-DB integration. Vectors live in the file store; embeddings come from the built-in local MiniLM or from a connection's embedding model." Semantic memory: "embedded with the local `all-MiniLM-L6-v2` or the chat connection's embedding model".

title: New xAI connections prefill Grok 4.7, not Grok 4.5
skill_evidence: references/architecture.md:296 "xAI default model (v2.2) — new xAI connections now prefill **Grok 4.5** (`grok-4.5`, 1M context; `grok-4.5-latest` also available)."
reality: ConnectionEditor.tsx:1662-1680 seeds the model from `MODEL_LISTS[key]?.[0]` and falls back to 'grok-4.5' only when the list is empty. MODEL_LISTS.xai = XAI_MODELS (model-lists.ts:1147), and its first entry is `{ id: "grok-4.7", context: 500000 }` (model-lists.ts:521). So a new xAI connection prefills grok-4.7 with a 500k max context.
fix: Mark the v2.2 note as historical: "(v2.2 prefilled Grok 4.5; at v2.5.0 a new xAI connection prefills the top of the xAI list, **Grok 4.7**, `grok-4.7`, 500k context)". Or drop the prefill claim and keep the existing advice to read model-lists.ts.
